meaning:
1) loves, amours (only in plural) ahbym
2) (TWOT) love

renderings.kjv: Let her be as the loving

elsewhere.note: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
